[preface]
== About me

I'm Tyrone Marhguy, a Computer Engineering student at the https://www.upenn.edu[University of Pennsylvania], class of 2028. FramePort is the VS Code extension I wrote for HDMI and USB capture, published on https://open-vsx.org/extension/tmarhguy/frameport[Open VSX].

I grew up between Kumasi and Accra. In 2021, Achimota School denied me admission because I wear dreadlocks as an expression of my Rastafarian faith. Ghana's High Court ordered the school to admit me; I finished secondary school there, then came to Penn on a full scholarship. https://www.bbc.com/pidgin/world-57306291[BBC Pidgin] and https://www.dw.com/en/ghana-rastafarians-start-school-after-court-victory/video-57864466[Deutsche Welle] covered the case.

I design the architecture, build the boards, and write the software. https://tomato.tmarhguy.com[Tomato] is a 32-bit computer with a running FPGA implementation and discrete boards in progress. I also build systems software, including a search engine, a compiler, and a database, and I contribute fixes to open-source EDA tools such as LibreLane, OpenROAD, Verilator, and OpenFPGA. That work has included production software at Aragorn AI and battery-management hardware at Vero Electric.

=== Hardware

* https://tomato.tmarhguy.com[Tomato], a 32-bit computer (https://github.com/tmarhguy/tomato[repository])
* https://github.com/tmarhguy/gpu[Pineapple GPU], a programmable 3D GPU on a Nexys A7
* https://github.com/tmarhguy/riscv[riscv64xO3], a 2-wide out-of-order RV64IMAC
* https://github.com/tmarhguy/mac[MAC], a BFloat16 multiply-accumulate for SkyWater 130 nm
* https://github.com/tmarhguy/udp-stack[UDP/IP stack], a 100 Mbps datapath on a Nexys A7
* https://github.com/tmarhguy/itch-hw[ITCH parser], NASDAQ ITCH 5.0 on a Nexys A7
* https://github.com/tmarhguy/mac-unit[6T SRAM], a full-custom SRAM study
* https://alu.tmarhguy.com[8-bit discrete ALU]
